assertion.statement: One scalar element fixes every permitted ring-class field and their finite composita while acting as u^4 on T2(E); hence one2^e, e=n+2, kills all their invariant2-primary torsion. Fixed squared matrix preimages also span a full2-power multiple of M2(Z2) in every quadratic subgroup.
assertion.objects: The fixed non-CM curve, scalar preimage g with u=1+2^n, actual complex conjugation tau, z=g² tau g² tau inverse, and fixed elementary matrix preimages.
assertion.hypotheses: The fixed open-image congruence subgroup with n≥2 is supplied; ring-class reciprocity gives abelian Galois groups over each imaginary quadratic K and conjugation inversion.
assertion.quantifiers: Every permitted imaginary quadratic K, ring-class conductor and finite compositum used in a construction; every quadratic subgroup for the matrix-span assertion.
assertion.parameter_range: The fixed E and its2-adic Tate module; no restriction on number of conductor primes.
assertion.uniformity: The same e and the same finite matrix-span witness depend only on E, not K, conductors or finite family size.
assertion.constants: u=1+2^n; v2(u^4−1)=n+2; squared matrix span contains2^(n+1)M2(Z2).
assertion.normalizations: g² fixes every quadratic field; conjugation inverts the ring-class image, so z fixes it. The matrix witness uses squares, not assumed residual irreducibility.
assertion.exceptional_cases: This proves invariant torsion annihilation and characteristic-zero matrix span, not residual rank-two localization or a bound on arbitrary non-ring-class extensions.
assertion.limit_order: Choose one open-image depth and preimages for E; form the scalar commutator and matrix squares; use actual ring-class inversion; deduce uniform torsion and span bounds.
